page.layout: One column of running text, set centred on the page. Running head across the top, with the printed page number at the top right. Below the text, one bare letter "D" stands at the centre (catchword).

main_text.p: modo à nobis allegata. Et p. 23. libenter inquit, fatemur summum Ma-gistratum curam gerere debere, ne disci-plina Ecclesiastica in abusum trahatur, quemadmodum in Papatu contigit: & p. 43. diximus superius & patebit etiam in sequentibus satis ex verbo Dei; officium supremorum Magistratuum esse curam gerere totius cultus divini & consequenter quoque operam dare, ut haec potestas spiri-tualis, (censura Ecclesiastica) non in abusum trahatur, quemadmodum notorie in Papatu contigit. Et. p.44. ait inter caetera, in talibus casibus (quos ipse extraordinarios recte vocat si cogitetur, quando alicui injuria fit per di-sciplinam Ecclesiasticam, id extra seu potius contra ordinem à Christo in-stitutum fieri) Magistratus tanquam nutricios Ecclesiæ posse cognitionem suscipere causarum & rationum excommuni-cationis, aut antequam ea sit instituta, aut postquam facta sit, nec posse eos, qui Ecclesiæ præsunt recusare iis redditionem rationis facti sui; & confirmat id ex

page.notes: The running head's opening symbol is a section-mark-like glyph (printed as a looped Q); transcribed here as §. Page number 73 is printed in old-style figures and is read with some uncertainty. The text runs over onto the next page ("ex" ends the page), so the paragraph is not closed. No marginal notes are printed. The lower "D" is taken as a catchword, although it is set centred rather than at the right.
